title: Angular
label: Angular
desc: Opinionated TypeScript framework with dependency injection, routing and signals built in.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Install the CLI, scaffold a standalone workspace and start the dev server.

snippets.code:
# Install the CLI globally, then create a standalone workspace
npm install -g @angular/cli
ng new shop --style=scss --routing --ssr=false
cd shop

# Daily commands
ng serve --port 4200 --open
ng generate component product-card
ng build --configuration production
